name: Checkbox
label: Checkbox
description: Custom checkbox with check and indeterminate states, keyboard accessible with animated transitions.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message rendered under the label text

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — recolours the helper text and marks the checkbox invalid

props.name: checked
props.description:
Whether the checkbox is checked, controlled. Leave undefined to let the
checkbox keep its own state, seeded from `defaultChecked`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the checkbox starts checked when uncontrolled (`checked` undefined).

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether the checkbox is in an indeterminate state

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the checkbox is disabled

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the next checked state when toggled

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the checkbox submits with an enclosing form
through a hidden input: `value` while checked, nothing while unchecked
or disabled, as a native checkbox does.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted under `name` while checked. Defaults to "on", the native checkbox's.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message rendered below the group

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — recolours the helper text and marks the group invalid

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group required and renders the required marker on its label

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name shared by every item. When set, each checked item submits
its `value` under this name through a hidden input, so a form reads the
selection as repeated entries, as a set of native checkboxes does; a disabled
item submits nothing.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; value: string; disabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]
props.description: Checkbox options

props.name: values
props.description:
Currently selected values, controlled. Leave undefined to let the group
keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValues`.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: Selected values on first render when uncontrolled (`values` undefined).

props.name: direction
props.description: Layout direction

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called with the next selected values

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the box shows its check.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether the box shows the minus of an indeterminate state (ignored when `checked`).

props.name: size
props.description: Box size: `default` is 24px, `compact` 20px.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
